record.name: Pirkka pekoni 140 g
record.licence: Public product label data and AFCD Release 3 food-category composition correspondence.
record.polyolsEvidence: The exact product ingredient declaration contains no fibre or sugar-alcohol ingredient. AFCD F000228 (https://www.foodstandards.gov.au/science-data/food-nutrient-databases/afcd/data-files) reports zero fibre and identical available carbohydrate with and without sugar alcohols (0.2 g/100 g) for raw plain bacon.
